title: Spurious Regression: · Cointegration (Engle-Granger / Johansen test)
prompt: **Spurious Regression:** If you regress two completely independent random walks $X_t = X_{t-1} + \epsilon_t$ and $Y_t = Y_{t-1} + \eta_t$ against each other, why do you frequently get a high $R^2$ and a statistically significant $t$-statistic? Explain **Cointegration (Engle-Granger / Johansen test)** in pairs trading.
